subject: Q3 renewal sweep: commit health, billing latency & churn heatmap
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwave.ai>, contracts@brightwave.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 renewal sweep: commit health, billing latency & churn heatmap

Team / Sam —

Quick pulse: Finance asked for a tight sweep on Q3 renewals where billing or stage drift looks material. I attached a heatmap (q3_commit_health_churn_heatmap.xlsx) I ran overnight that combines: current stage, last invoice date, open escalation tickets, and a churn-propensity signal we use in the renewal model.

Top line: BrightWave shows two areas of friction — billing latency (invoices delayed >14 days) and a cluster of accounts in "Committed" >60 days with little product usage uplift.

Can you each take the sections below and reply with a short status + next step before EOD tomorrow? I'll compile and route to FinOps for potential credit holds.

- Ben: double-check billing ledger and confirm whether the 3 invoices flagged are payment retries or contract disputes. If retries, propose charge timing / retry window.
- Marissa: validate stage accuracy for the six accounts listed as "Committed (stale)" and attach any recent engagement notes. If a deal needs stage-change, call out reason.
- David: assess technical escalation tickets for those accounts and flag any SLO risks; propose remediation owner if needed.

Sam / contracts: if you have any updates on PO timing or signed amendments, paste here.

Attachments: q3_commit_health_churn_heatmap.xlsx, BW-MAP-MutualActionPlan-v2.pdf

Thanks — short replies appreciated.

Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwave.ai>, contracts@brightwave.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal sweep: commit health, billing latency & churn heatmap

On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 09:13 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Sam —
>
> Quick pulse: Finance asked for a tight sweep on Q3 renewals...

Quick update from finance side: the three flagged invoices are two auto-retry failures (card on file expired) and one is an invoice dispute where BrightWave requested a line-item correction (they disputed a usage charge). I'm pinging Payments to refresh card info and will open a short ticket for the dispute resolution.

Actionable: Payments will attempt a scheduled retry tomorrow (9/15) at 14:00 PT. If that fails, request to hold renewal credit until resolved.

Ben
Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Q3 renewal sweep: commit health, billing latency & churn heatmap

Forwarding my notes + the cleaned tab from the heatmap (see attached sheet in q3_commit_health_churn_heatmap.xlsx). Short bullets per account:

- BrightWave (BW-4231): "Committed" flagged — last product touch 2027-06-10, CSM notes show roadmap sync planned but postponed. No legal docs outstanding. Recommended: change stage to "Customer Success Review" and schedule 1:1 with Sam this week.
- LumenData: correct stage (was mis-mapped) — leave in Committed.
- AltoHealth: flagged for usage drop; CSM will run adoption play and has owner assigned.

I've appended quick links to recent call notes in the Drive folder. If we move BrightWave back to "Customer Success Review" that will drop the commit ARR for the forecast by $58k — call this out explicitly to Finance if they need GOP adjustments.

Attachments in my reply: updated_heatmap_BW_tab (inside q3_commit_health_churn_heatmap.xlsx)

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwave.ai>, contracts@brightwave.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal sweep: commit health, billing latency & churn heatmap

Thanks — I reviewed the three BrightWave technical tickets. Summary: two are outstanding minor performance regressions tied to a custom plugin (low severity) and one is an unresolved alert pattern that could impact inference throughput during heavy batch runs.

Proposed remediation: assign a short-term mitigation to the infra-oncall (workaround: scale worker pool during scheduled runs) and create a low-priority engineering task to replace the custom plugin before renewal. I can own the remediation coordination and will loop in Infra leads.

I'll be on the call Friday at 10:00 PT to walk through the mitigation plan.

David Kim
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwave.ai>, contracts@brightwave.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal sweep: commit health, billing latency & churn heatmap

Appreciate the quick turn, everyone. Short recap + next steps for handoff to Finance and CS: 

1) Billing: Ben to trigger retry (tomorrow 9/15 14:00 PT). If retry fails, Finance to place renewal on hold and Rachel to notify Sam.
2) Stage: Marissa recommends moving BrightWave to "Customer Success Review". Rachel to confirm with Sam in Friday call and update CRM.
3) Tech: David will own mitigation coordination; Infra to implement temporary scale for scheduled runs (owner: Infra-Oncall) and open Jira for plugin replacement.

Friday call: 2027-09-17 10:00 PT — invite sent (link in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBWQ3).

I'll compile this into a short MPC note for FinOps and attach the MAP PDF. If anyone has further objections to the proposed stage change, reply ASAP.

Rachel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
